quote: We measure fidelity of edited ingredient lists against ground truth, we calculate Jaccard similarity (IoU) and F1 scores , and precision and F1 for insertions and deletions. We measure the fluency of generated directions via ROUGE-L , a metric that assesses n-gram overlap between edited and gold recipe texts. We measure diversity via the percentage of distinct bigrams (D-2) across edited recipes.
